name: IsTranslationEquivariant
doc:
分数 `f i j` 平移等变：对所有平移量 `k`，`f (i+k) (j+k) = f i j`。
这是「只依赖相对位置」的抽象形式，RoPE（相位差）与 ALiBi（距离偏置）都满足。
stmt: def IsTranslationEquivariant {ι : Type*} [Add ι] (f : ι → ι → ℝ) : Prop
proof: ∀ i j k : ι, f (i + k) (j + k) = f i j

name: distBias
doc: 距离偏置：`β` 是「距离 ⟹ 偏置」的函数，`distBias β i j` 只通过 `Nat.dist i j` 依赖位置。
stmt: def distBias (β : ℕ → ℝ) (i j : ℕ) : ℝ
proof: β (Nat.dist i j)

name: scoreAdd
doc: 加法相对位置分数：标准分数 + 一般偏置项（ALiBi 是其 `β = −m·id` 特例）。
stmt: def scoreAdd (s b : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (i j : ℕ) : ℝ
proof: s i j + b i j

name: scoreDistAdd
doc: 加法相对位置分数（距离形式）：标准分数 + 只依赖 `Nat.dist i j` 的偏置。
stmt: def scoreDistAdd (s : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (β : ℕ → ℝ) (i j : ℕ) : ℝ
proof: s i j + distBias β i j

name: dist_translation_invariant
stmt:
theorem dist_translation_invariant (i j k : ℕ) :
    Nat.dist (i + k) (j + k) = Nat.dist i j
proof:
by
  simp only [Nat.dist]
  omega

name: nat_metric_dist_translation
stmt:
lemma nat_metric_dist_translation (i j k : ℕ) :
    dist (i + k) (j + k) = dist i j
proof:
by
  rw [Nat.dist_eq, Nat.dist_eq]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

name: additive_relpos_equivariance
stmt:
theorem additive_relpos_equivariance (β : ℕ → ℝ) (i j k : ℕ) :
    distBias β (i + k) (j + k) = distBias β i j
proof:
by
  unfold distBias
  rw [dist_translation_invariant]

name: alibi_bias_translation_equivariant
stmt:
theorem alibi_bias_translation_equivariant (m : ℝ) :
    IsTranslationEquivariant (fun i j : ℕ => alibiBias m i j)
proof:
by
  intro i j k
  dsimp only [alibiBias]
  rw [nat_metric_dist_translation]

name: distBias_equivariant
stmt:
theorem distBias_equivariant (β : ℕ → ℝ) :
    IsTranslationEquivariant (fun i j : ℕ => distBias β i j)
proof:
by
  intro i j k
  exact additive_relpos_equivariance β i j k

name: additive_relpos_score_lipschitz
stmt:
theorem additive_relpos_score_lipschitz (s b b' : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (i j : ℕ) :
    |scoreAdd s b i j - scoreAdd s b' i j| ≤ |b i j - b' i j|
proof:
by
  unfold scoreAdd
  have h : s i j + b i j - (s i j + b' i j) = b i j - b' i j := by ring
  rw [h]

name: additive_relpos_scoreDist_lipschitz
stmt:
theorem additive_relpos_scoreDist_lipschitz (s : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (β β' : ℕ → ℝ) (i j : ℕ) :
    |scoreDistAdd s β i j - scoreDistAdd s β' i j| ≤ |distBias β i j - distBias β' i j|
proof:
by
  unfold scoreDistAdd
  have h : s i j + distBias β i j - (s i j + distBias β' i j) =
      distBias β i j - distBias β' i j := by ring
  rw [h]

name: rope_score_translation_equivariant
stmt:
theorem rope_score_translation_equivariant (θ : ℝ) (q k : Point2R) :
    IsTranslationEquivariant
      (fun a b : ℝ => rdot (rotateR (a * θ) q) (rotateR (b * θ) k))
proof:
by
  intro a b t
  change rdot (rotateR ((a + t) * θ) q) (rotateR ((b + t) * θ) k) =
    rdot (rotateR (a * θ) q) (rotateR (b * θ) k)
  have h1 : rdot (rotateR ((a + t) * θ) q) (rotateR ((b + t) * θ) k)
      = rdot q (rotateR (((b + t) - (a + t)) * θ) k) :=
    rope_relative_preserves_dot (a + t) (b + t) θ q k
  have h2 : rdot (rotateR (a * θ) q) (rotateR (b * θ) k)
      = rdot q (rotateR ((b - a) * θ) k) :=
    rope_relative_preserves_dot a b θ q k
  rw [h1, h2]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  ring

name: relPhaseFactor
doc: 相对相位因子：位置 i、j 的相位差 `e^{iθ(j−i)}`（RealComplexRoPE 的相位部分）。
stmt: def relPhaseFactor (θ : ℝ) (i j : ℕ) : ℂ
proof: Complex.exp (((θ * ((j : ℝ) - (i : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)

name: relPhaseAbs
doc: 相位因子的**模**（= 1），实数版接口成员：`|e^{iθ(j−i)}| = 1`，平移不变。
stmt: def relPhaseAbs (θ : ℝ) (i j : ℕ) : ℝ
proof: Complex.abs (relPhaseFactor θ i j)

name: relPhaseAbs_translation_equivariant
stmt:
theorem relPhaseAbs_translation_equivariant (θ : ℝ) :
    IsTranslationEquivariant (fun i j : ℕ => relPhaseAbs θ i j)
proof:
by
  intro i j k
  change Complex.abs (relPhaseFactor θ (i + k) (j + k)) = Complex.abs (relPhaseFactor θ i j)
  have h : ((θ * (((j + k : ℕ) : ℝ) - ((i + k : ℕ) : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ((θ * ((j : ℝ) - (i : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  unfold relPhaseFactor
  rw [h]

name: relpos_family_unified
stmt:
theorem relpos_family_unified (β : ℕ → ℝ) (m θ : ℝ) (q k : Point2R) :
    IsTranslationEquivariant (fun i j : ℕ => distBias β i j) ∧
    IsTranslationEquivariant (fun i j : ℕ => alibiBias m i j) ∧
    IsTranslationEquivariant
      (fun a b : ℝ => rdot (rotateR (a * θ) q) (rotateR (b * θ) k)) ∧
    IsTranslationEquivariant (fun i j : ℕ => relPhaseAbs θ i j)
proof:
⟨distBias_equivariant β, alibi_bias_translation_equivariant m,
    rope_score_translation_equivariant θ q k, relPhaseAbs_translation_equivariant θ⟩

                               
                                             
                                           
                                     
                                                             

end Lattice

name: rotateR
stmt: def rotateR (θ : ℝ) (p : Point2R) : Point2R
proof:
{ x := p.x * Real.cos θ - p.y * Real.sin θ
    y := p.x * Real.sin θ + p.y * Real.cos θ }

name: rotate_preserves_dot
stmt:
lemma rotate_preserves_dot (θ : ℝ) (q k : Point2R) :
    rdot (rotateR θ q) (rotateR θ k) = rdot q k
proof:
by
  unfold rdot rotateR
  dsimp
                      
  have hcs : Real.cos θ ^ 2 + Real.sin θ ^ 2 = 1 := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
  calc
    (q.x * Real.cos θ - q.y * Real.sin θ) * (k.x * Real.cos θ - k.y * Real.sin θ) +
        (q.x * Real.sin θ + q.y * Real.cos θ) * (k.x * Real.sin θ + k.y * Real.cos θ)
        = q.x * k.x * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 + Real.sin θ ^ 2) +
          q.y * k.y * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 + Real.sin θ ^ 2) := by ring
    _ = q.x * k.x + q.y * k.y := by rw [hcs]; ring

name: rotate_compose
stmt:
lemma rotate_compose (a b : ℝ) (p : Point2R) :
    rotateR a (rotateR b p) = rotateR (a + b) p
proof:
by
  unfold rotateR
  dsimp
                                            
  have hcos : Real.cos (a + b) = Real.cos a * Real.cos b - Real.sin a * Real.sin b := Real.cos_add a b
                                            
  have hsin : Real.sin (a + b) = Real.sin a * Real.cos b + Real.cos a * Real.sin b := Real.sin_add a b
                    
  rw [Point2R.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  · rw [hcos, hsin]
    ring
  · rw [hcos, hsin]
    ring

name: rope_relative_preserves_dot
stmt:
theorem rope_relative_preserves_dot (m n θ : ℝ) (q k : Point2R) :
    rdot (rotateR (m * θ) q) (rotateR (n * θ) k) = rdot q (rotateR ((n - m) * θ) k)
proof:
by
                                  
  have hcompose : rotateR (n * θ) k = rotateR (m * θ) (rotateR ((n - m) * θ) k) := by
    have hsum : m * θ + (n - m) * θ = n * θ := by ring
                                                                                   
    calc
      rotateR (n * θ) k = rotateR (m * θ + (n - m) * θ) k := by rw [hsum]
      _ = rotateR (m * θ) (rotateR ((n - m) * θ) k) := (rotate_compose (m * θ) ((n - m) * θ) k).symm
                                                    
  rw [hcompose]
  exact rotate_preserves_dot (m * θ) q (rotateR ((n - m) * θ) k)

                           
                                                          
                                         

end Lattice
